class.name: autoware_mini/PredictedTrajectory
class.description: Displays predicted trajectories from DetectedObjectArray messages as colored ribbons or lines. Directly renders to OGRE without using the ROS marker system.

class.name: autoware_mini/DetectedObjects
class.description: Displays detected objects from DetectedObjectArray messages as 3D bounding boxes, convex hulls, velocity arrows, and text labels. Directly renders to OGRE without using the ROS marker system.

class.name: autoware_mini/LocalPath
class.description: Displays the local path from LocalPath messages as a colored ribbon with velocity labels and stopping point marker. Directly renders to OGRE without using the ROS marker system.

class.name: autoware_mini/HeadingAlignedOrtho
class.description: Top-down orthographic RViz view that tracks both the target TF frame's position and its yaw rotation, so the target frame's forward axis always points up on screen. Used for vehicle-aligned remote assistance views.
